description: Strongly identify the caller. Call this first, with the personal identity code (henkilötunnus) the caller says. The server confirms it with Mobile ID and returns who the caller is and their own open case, if they have one. Nothing about the caller is available before this succeeds.
name: verify_identity

hetu.description: The caller's personal identity code exactly as they said it, format DDMMYY-NNNX, e.g. 131052-308T.
